cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (4096 MB = 4 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

queryport.desc: Steam query port (UDP), used by the server browser

servername.desc: Name shown in the server browser

serverpassword.desc: Password players need to join. Empty means anyone can join

public.desc: List the server in the public server browser

commands: bash -c "for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do steamcmd +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType linux +force_install_dir /SkyPanel +login anonymous +app_update 1026340 validate +quit && exit 0; echo 'steamcmd could not finish the download, trying again in 15s ($try/5)'; sleep 15; done; exit 1"

bash -c "mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64; for d in .steam .steam/steamcmd .local/share/Steam/steamcmd steamcmd; do if [ -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/; fi; if [ -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so ]; then cp -f $d/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/; fi; done; true"

install.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<serversettings
  name="${servername}"
  public="${public}"
  port="${port}"
  queryport="${queryport}"
  maxplayers="${maxplayers}"
  password="${serverpassword}"
  enableupnp="false"
  tickrate="20"
  randomizeseed="True"
  userespawnshuttle="True"
  respawninterval="300"
  maxtransporttime="180"
  minrespawnratio="0.2"
  autorestart="false"
  autorestartinterval="60"
  startwhenclientsready="False"
  startwhenclientsreadyratio="0.8"
  allowspectating="True"
  voipenabled="True"
  endroundatlevelend="True"
  saveserverlogs="True"
  allowragdollbutton="True"
  allowfiletransfers="True"
  voicechatenabled="True"
  allowvotekick="True"
  allowendvoting="True"
  allowrespawn="True"
  botcount="0"
  maxbotcount="16"
  allowdisguises="True"
  subselectionmode="Manual"
  modeselectionmode="Manual"
  endvoterequiredratio="0.6"
  kickvoterequiredratio="0.6"
  killdisconnectedtime="30"
  kickafktime="120"
  traitoruseratio="True"
  traitorratio="0.2"
  karmaenabled="False"
  gamemodeidentifier="sandbox"
  missiontype="Random"
  autobantime="60"
  maxautobantime="360"
  SubSelection="Manual"
  LevelDifficulty="20"
  TraitorsEnabled="No"
  BotSpawnMode="Normal"
  AllowedRandomMissionTypes="Random,Salvage,Monster,Cargo,Combat"
  AllowedClientNameChars="32-33,38-46,48-57,65-90,91,93,95-122,192-255,384-591,1024-1279"
  ServerMessage=""
/>
